# Frontend Release Gate Full Guide

Use this guide for final release-risk review and sign-off.

## Scope

- Feature readiness and correctness
- Test/build confidence
- Accessibility and performance impact
- Rollback and incident readiness

## Core Playbook

1. Verify changed behavior and tests.
2. Evaluate performance and accessibility deltas.
3. Record residual risks and mitigations.
4. Produce explicit go/no-go decision.
